author: ojiudezue
title: Room-to-room agentic layer written into the memory vision as the next stage, parked until OC is proven
summary: Memory stays a read-only, per-node history (no bus, no cross-writes). The operator's room-to-room communication idea becomes a parked next stage modelled on the OC agent loop; revisit after the OC live eval passes and the first OC production slice ships.
why: The first OC live run failed on root cause and invented citations. Many agents talking to each other would multiply exactly those failure modes, so the single-agent loop has to be proven first. Nothing open in memory (outcome() stub, 4 writer-less episode types, zone_phantom) blocks OC.
implications: No memory build work queued. P8 (memory feeding safety/occupancy/reserve decisions) stays parked permanently even for room agents.
revisit_trigger: OC live-eval full round passes AND first OC production slice ships.
